decision_statement: Invoice Atelier Exemple SARL (SIRET 12345678901234) 250 EUR excluding tax, 300 EUR including tax, due 2026-10-25, unpaid, by running the confirmed Luce program example.invoice.create_unpaid on the inputs whose digest the attachment names.
context_at_decision: The work was delivered; the client exists or is created with its exact SIRET; the invoice must be issued before the due date agreed by e-mail.
options_considered: Issue the invoice now through the confirmed program (chosen): exact client, read back, receipts kept.
Issue it by hand in the accounting tool: no read-back and no receipt, so no proof of what was sent.
Wait for the monthly batch: the agreed due date would pass.
required_inputs_used: SIRET checked in the public register
assumptions_depended_on: The amount excluding tax agreed by e-mail is 250 EUR.
success_criteria: The invoice is read back with 300 EUR including tax, due 2026-10-25, unpaid.

affirmation_record.method: person_approval signature over the Luce payload hash

mode_classification_attestation.attestation_text_signed: I attest that this decision record was dispatched in mode-1 with an embedded mode-2 summary under charter CH-EXAMPLE-BILLING-1: the PRIA runtime prepared the confirmed Luce program and its inputs; I reviewed them as shown, weighed the three options recorded here, signed with my own key the exact payload whose digest the attachment names, and I am the accountable owner of this decision as an employee.

re_decision_trigger: Any read-back that differs from the confirmed version, or an uncertain effect receipt.
